boundaries.runtime_evidence: NOT_RUN in this source inventory; final commit and deployed contract are bound by evidence/observability/issue513-*.json, not a self-referential hash.
boundaries.source_fingerprint: SHA-256 of UTF-8 text with universal newlines normalized to LF; independent of CRLF checkout and locale. Producer paths and owner lists use deterministic POSIX ordering.
boundaries.metric_names: OTLP names are the pinned Collector Prometheus translation contract; compare actual stored families in runtime evidence. Histogram suffixes are _bucket/_sum/_count.
boundaries.metrics_identity: No user/session/visit/flow/media/trace/request/track IDs, raw URLs or error text in metric labels. Resource label allowlist is separately configured in Collector.
boundaries.duplicate_sources: Private collectors are not OTLP automatically. Do not sum a native series and its mirror or conflate independent installations/replicas.
boundaries.missing_data: Missing/stale/unavailable is never healthy zero. A successful relay response is not stored/queryable Tempo proof.

scenarios.coverage_and_limits: Auth application events; session-probe operational aggregates; realtime session-revalidation failures. A 401 is not a fabricated authenticated user. Client prelogin batches are not exported.

Server route event records acceptance/rejection; client message.send root waits for mounted sender render, retries share flow ID with distinct attempts. Reply/mentions reuse the send route; no content or receiver read receipt.
Upload events plus bounded failure/status/latency and filesystem snapshots. No attachment bytes, filenames or local paths.
Fixed route events/outcomes and aggregate HTTP duration. Search query text and matched message text are never telemetry.
Reactions/pins use bounded application events; mentions are part of message send. No per-render or per-recipient trace.

scenarios.scenario: Topology, account controls and guild settings
scenarios.coverage_and_limits: Fixed admin route events, guild settings/update stages and counters; administrator status does not grant DM telemetry payload access.

Lease/credential routes and action/worker stages distinguish connection from actual audibility. PTT/audio state is sampled; do not create a trace for every PTT edge or claim physical audio acceptance.

screen.view terminal is actual presented first frame where supported, not HTTP ack. app.media and legacy media samples preserve direction/provenance, age and units. Fullscreen/mini do not imply new media session; unsupported cross-publication correlation remains explicit.
Actual server transitions and stop/error traces retained. Successful unscoped polling/heartbeat omitted; full HTTP counts/latency remain independent. No viewer IDs in metric labels.
Bounded desktop.update phase/reason/version/duration_ms legacy span and private server catalog/check metrics. Not an invented app.flow chain or proof that update is installed.

scenarios.scenario: Producer queue, relay, exporters and store visibility
scenarios.coverage_and_limits: Keep queue/dropped/retried/accepted distinct. Relay last_accept is receipt age per platform, not Tempo storage success. Collector/Tempo internal metrics and synthetic stored trace prove later stages independently.
Native private pool collectors and OTLP incident mirrors expose bounded statistics/outcomes; no SQL/DSN/query text.

scenarios.scenario: Storage admission, private filesystem capacity and readiness
scenarios.coverage_and_limits: On-demand filesystem snapshots may be absent on collector-only wiring; scheduled storage probe is availability, not capacity or a backup.

scenarios.scenario: SFU control transport, roster and aggregate media health
scenarios.coverage_and_limits: Private Ping/control/roster aggregates and optional allowlisted LiveKit scrape. No RTP/RTCP proxy or load/capacity claim.
Separate WebSocket lifetime from readiness/event delivery. Worker links preserve causality and attempts; no per-message/DM payload logging.
Bounded registrations/daily-active/collection signals are opt-in installation aggregates; compare replicas using max rather than summing duplicate snapshots.
